sources.title: FoodKeeper Data (English)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food Safety and Inspection Service
sources.licenseNote: Licence stated on the data.gov catalog entry (last modified 2025-01-22). Structured data: 661 products in 25 categories (33 fresh fruits, 68 fresh vegetables) with min/max storage times for pantry, fridge and freezer, from purchase and after opening, plus tips. Times are US guidance (fridge assumed at 40 °F / 4 °C). Some tips cite third parties (e.g. 'The United States Potato Board notes ...'); keep those attributions. The data itself is version 128 from 2018-09-06; the 2025 date on data.gov refers to the catalog entry. Show the data date in the app.
sources.attribution: Source: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service, FoodKeeper data (CC0).
sources.retrievalNote: FSIS blocks scripted downloads (HTTP 403). Saved via a browser on 2026-10-24; checksum matched the one computed in the browser.

sources.title: The Commercial Storage of Fruits, Vegetables, and Florist and Nursery Stocks (Agriculture Handbook 66, rev. 2016)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service
sources.licenseNote: 792 pages; per-crop storage temperature, humidity and storage life for 138 commodities. No copyright notice in the publication. Works by US federal employees are public domain, but the commodity summaries were written by 'nearly a hundred experts', many at universities, and some figures are 'reprinted with permission' (e.g. Copyright 1999 Elsevier). Needs a per-chapter authorship check, or confirmation from USDA ARS, before use. Commercial storage conditions, not home storage.
sources.attribution: USDA Agricultural Research Service, Agriculture Handbook 66: The Commercial Storage of Fruits, Vegetables, and Florist and Nursery Stocks (rev. 2016), eds. K.C. Gross, C.Y. Wang, M. Saltveit.
